newsitem.title: INDIA: At least seven killed in India house collapse.
newsitem.headline: At least seven killed in India house collapse.

text.p: At least seven people were killed and nine injured when three residential buildings collapsed in the Indian capital on Thursday, the United News of India (UNI) reported.

There were two women and four children among the dead, UNI said. The house collapsed after a cooking gas cylinder exploded in the Mongolpuri slum area in the Indian capital, it quoted fire officials as saying.
The explosion occurred at 9.05 a.m. (0335 GMT), UNI said.
The injured were rushed to New Delhi hospitals.
Rescue teams along with local residents have cleared the debris from the site of the collapse, UNI said.
Police and fire officials were not immediately available for comment.
